candidates.note: This is the single most important coverage fact in the inventory and it corroborates the parent Issue's warning to QA. No existing test can observe C11 or C12, because the harness answers 250 to any MAIL FROM and throws the DATA payload away. Three tests currently send a full message through this server and pass; they would still pass with a completely malformed envelope. Any RED probe for C11/C12/C25/C26/C27 requires extending or replacing this harness to retain the received lines first — otherwise the probe asserts on send success, which is exactly the false-negative the parent Issue told QA to avoid. must_fail_old is FALSE because this candidate describes harness capability, not production behavior; it is not itself a RED target.
